name.description: Display name for the plugin in the account settings UI.

icon.description: Theme icon identifier (e.g., 'account-google'). Should match an installed icon in the Lomiri icon theme.

services.description: List of Google services supported by this plugin. Each service defines its own OAuth scopes and API endpoints.

id.description: Unique lowercase identifier (e.g., 'calendar', 'contacts'). Used in section headers.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the service selection list.

scopes.description: List of OAuth2 scope URLs required to access the service.

discovery_url.description: Google Discovery API URL for this service (used to fetch service metadata).

resource_auth.description: Whether the service supports fine-grained, resource-specific token permissions.

default_permissions.description: (Optional) Default permission level for token scopes ('read', 'read-write', etc.).

auth_client_id.description: Google Cloud Console OAuth2 client ID. Required. Must be created with redirect URI matching 'RedirectUri'.

auth_client_secret.description: Google Cloud Console OAuth2 client secret. *Highly sensitive*. Must be stored securely (e.g., via secrets management).

auth_redirect_uri.description: OAuth2 redirect URI. Must be registered in Google Cloud Console. Use 'urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob' for desktop or a custom URI scheme (e.g., 'myapp://oauth') for mobile.

token_endpoint.description: Google OAuth2 token endpoint (for exchange of auth code and refresh tokens).

revoke_endpoint.description: Google OAuth2 revocation endpoint (used to invalidate tokens on sign-out).

auth_refresh_mode.description: Token refresh strategy. 'auto' refreshes tokens transparently; 'manual' prompts user on expiry.

auth_use_pkce.description: Enable Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) for additional OAuth security (recommended).

allow_auto_provision.description: If true, users can add Google accounts via the UI. If false, accounts must be pre-provisioned (e.g., for enterprise deployments).

sync_max_concurrent.description: Maximum number of simultaneous sync operations per account.

sync_min_interval.description: Minimum allowed sync interval in seconds (e.g., 5 minutes). Prevents excessive polling.

sync_default_interval.description: Default background sync interval in seconds (e.g., 1 hour).

sync_enable_background.description: Enable background sync by default (requires user to disable manually if desired).

sync_wifi_only.description: If true, syncs requiring large transfers will only run when Wi-Fi is available.
